eyebrow: Git & GitHub for Software Engineers · Chapter One
subtitle: Lesson 4 · Git Fundamentals

code:
git branch feature-login     # create (doesn't switch)
git switch feature-login      # switch to it

# or both at once:
git switch -c feature-login

# older, equivalent form:
git checkout -b feature-login
caption: A branch is a pointer, not a copy — creating one is instant and cheap.
GitHub's branch dropdown on a repository's file tree — every branch, no terminal required.

eyebrow: Creating a branch in the browser
caption: Typing a new name into that selector offers to create it — the web equivalent of switch -c.

eyebrow: Deleting a branch in the browser
caption: The Branches page lists every branch with a trash icon — the web equivalent of git branch -d.

subtitle: Two ways to combine branches back together.
